title: Auth — Signing Key Authorize — payload
description: The terms of one signing-key enrolment, signed by the identity the key will act for. Exactly the payload of the auth/signing-key/enroll/0.2 document that carries this one as its `authorization`, with that member removed; the consumer compares the two and refuses any difference. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

identityDid.description: The identity authorizing the delegation. Equal to the document's `issuer`: the identity signs for itself.

expiresAt.description: The lifetime the enrolment requests, as in auth/signing-key/enroll/0.2.

replaces.description: The identity's active key the enrolment replaces, as in auth/signing-key/enroll/0.2. Signed here so an authorization to add a key cannot be reused to remove one.
